record.title: Overgeared
record.description:
Shin Youngwoo is a pure loser in life who is also heavily indebted to an insurance company. He lives with his disappointed parents and brilliant younger sister who is one of the top students at her school. Even in games, like the popular VRMMORPG game Satisfy, he's a total loser.  
But one day, while on a quest, he miraculously finds a Legendary Book that can give anyone who reads it the never-before-seen Legendary Class! He was planning to sell it for a lot of money but luck was always his worst trait. Through an unlucky change of the situation, his dream was short-lived as he was forced to use the item for himself. His life changed forever since that fateful day.

record.title: Overgeared (Novel)
record.description:
Shin Youngwoo has had an unfortunate life and is now stuck carrying bricks on construction sites. He even had to do labor in the VR game, Satisfy!

However, luck would soon enter his hapless life. His character, ‘Grid’, would discover the Northern End Cave for a quest, and in that place, he would find ‘Pagma’s Rare Book’ and become a legendary class player…

record.title: Overgeared (Team Argo)
record.description:
From Yen Press:  
Youngwoo Shin is a deadbeat in real life, working odd jobs to barely pay off his loans. Even his family has written him off as a hopeless video game addict. But when he logs in to the massively popular VR game Satisfy, Youngwoo becomes Grid the Warrior, who is also painfully mediocre. Everything changes when he stumbles across a tome containing the lost knowledge of a legendary blacksmith. The catch is, using it resets all his levels! In order to survive after being forced back to square one, Grid will need to hone his skills and gather reliable allies or not! Who needs all that when you're decked out in god-tier items?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%ED%85%9C%EB%B9%A8/2379), [Kakaopage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54727849)

record.title: Fanpai: Bei Tou Ting Xinsheng Hou, Nv Zhu Xiang Dang Wo Hougong!?
record.description:
Traveling to the world of novels, Tang Yu gets the villain role system.  
As long as the mission is successfully completed, he can get rich rewards and return to the real world.  
In this regard, Tang Yu can only accept it.  
But in the face of the extremely mindless heroine and plot setting, he couldn't help but complain, but he didn't expect the heroines to hear his heart.  
Bai Yixue gritted her teeth: "This bastard, he actually said that I am a cold ice mountain that no one wants, hehe, I must freeze him to death today!"  
Lin Qingying squeezed her fists: "This damn bastard actually said that I'm big-booded, brainless, and violent? So I won't be gentle!!"   
"....."  
Seeing the heroine whose personality gradually collapsed, Li Qingze became numb.  
"Hey! I'm the villain, it's fine if you don't follow the plot, and what do you mean with throwing yourself at me!"
